summary: Churchill Downs filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing the closing of an Eighth Amendment to its December 27, 2017 senior secured credit agreement and a new senior secured term loan B due 2033. The amendment extends the revolver and term loan A maturities from 2029 to September 25, 2031, while the 2033 term loan B matures September 25, 2033 and prices at SOFR plus 175 basis points. Proceeds repay term loan B-1 and revolver borrowings, fund fees and general corporate purposes. JPMorgan Chase serves as administrative agent. Obligations are guaranteed by subsidiary guarantors and secured by substantially all assets. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
